descriptionChirho: To physically raise or lift up something such as eyes, hands, or head, the basic literal sense of the verb in active voice.
To hoist or raise a sail in a nautical context, a specialized application of the lifting meaning.
To be lifted up or taken up passively, as in the bodily ascension of Christ into heaven.
To raise or lift up one's voice in speech or exclamation, a figurative extension of the physical lifting meaning.
To exalt or elevate oneself in pride or arrogance, used in the middle voice to indicate reflexive self-exaltation.
